contest.name: West Virginia QSO Party
contest.sponsor: West Virginia State Amateur Radio Council
contest.description: West Virginia QSO Party - held on the Saturday on or before June 20 (West Virginia statehood day), noon to midnight Eastern (1600Z Sat to 0400Z Sun). West Virginia stations work everyone; out-of-state stations work West Virginia stations only. Exchange is RST + 3-letter West Virginia county abbreviation for WV stations, or RST + state / province / DXCC country for everyone else. CW, SSB, and Digital (non-CW) - no WARC bands. Phone QSO = 1 point, CW and Digital QSO = 2 points. Out-of-state stations multiply by WV counties; WV stations multiply by WV counties + US states + Canadian provinces + DXCC entities (USA, Alaska, Hawaii, and Canada do not count as DXCC entities). Multipliers count once for the contest. Final score is QSO points x multipliers plus bonus points. Bonus station W8WVA is worth 100 points per band/mode QSO; WV mobiles additionally claim 100 points per WV county activated (a self-activation bonus that is not auto-tracked - add it manually to the claimed score).
contest.startDate: Saturday on or before June 20 (2026: June 20, 1600Z Sat to 0400Z Sun)

userPrompts.question: Select your station location
userPrompts.description: West Virginia stations work everyone; out-of-state stations work West Virginia stations only.

userPrompts.question: Select your entry category

options.label: Single Operator (Fixed) - one signal, one operator
Multi/Multi (Fixed) - unlimited signals and operators, one QTH
QRP (Fixed or Mobile) - one signal, one operator, 10 W Voice / 5 W CW max
Mobile - capable of operation while in motion

userPrompts.description: Submit an entry for only one category. Mobiles changing counties may be re-worked; a mobile on a non-wet county line counts as a QSO and a multiplier from each county. Remote operating and spotting nets are permitted.

userPrompts.question: Select your power level

options.label: QRP - 10 W Voice / 5 W CW or less

userPrompts.description: Power level is used for award classification only - WVQP has no power-based score multiplier.

userPrompts.question: Enter your exchange. WV stations: 3-letter county abbreviation (e.g., KAN for Kanawha, MON for Monongalia). Non-WV USA: 2-letter state (DC counts as MD). Canada: 2-letter province. DX: DX.
userPrompts.description: 3-letter West Virginia county code for WV stations; 2-letter US state (DC counts as MD) or Canadian province for non-WV W/VE; DX otherwise. WV Mobiles must change this when crossing into a new county.

sent.name: EXCHs
sent.description: 3-letter WV county for WV stations; 2-letter state/province for non-WV W/VE; DX otherwise

received.name: EXCHr
received.description: 3-letter WV county from WV stations; 2-letter state/province from W/VE; DX otherwise

multipliers.description: Multipliers count once for the contest. Out-of-state stations multiply by WV counties only (max 55). WV stations multiply by WV counties (55) + US states (50 max - the 49 other worked states plus WV itself, credited via automaticMultipliers once the WV operator works any WV station, since WV stations send their county rather than 'WV'; DC counts as MD via namedMultAliases) + 13 Canadian provinces + DXCC entities. USA, Alaska, Hawaii, and Canada are NOT counted as DXCC entities (alaskaAndHawaiiCountDxcc / usAndCanadaCountDxcc are false).

bonusStations.name: W8WVA West Virginia QSO Party Bonus Station
bonusStations.note: Work W8WVA once per band per mode for 100 bonus points per QSO, added to the final score. WV mobiles additionally claim 100 points per WV county activated - that self-activation bonus is not auto-tracked and must be added manually to the claimed score.

dupeChecking.description: Work a station once per band per mode. CW, SSB, and Digital count as separate modes - e.g. W1AW may be worked on 80m CW, 80m Digital, and 80m SSB for three contacts. All digital (non-CW) modes are equivalent: a station worked on 80m RTTY cannot be worked again on 80m PSK31. WV Mobiles changing counties count as a new station and may be re-worked; a mobile on a (non-wet) county line is logged as a separate QSO per county for both QSO and multiplier credit.

callHistory.description: Save received exchange (county or state/province) for future lookups

exchangeValidation.description: Exchange should be a 3-letter West Virginia county code for WV stations, a 2-letter US state code (DC counts as MD) or Canadian province code for non-WV W/VE, or DX for everyone outside USA/Canada. DXCC entity multipliers for WV operators are derived from the worked callsign, not the exchange string.
